thread:
Alice S.: Quick heads-up — Solarity Health POC kickoff next Mon. They want a signed MSA+DPA, orderform and a PO before we start. Procurement flagged: invoice + Net30, legal flagged DPA redlines, security wants SOC2 + KMS details. Can we get a cross-functional runbook to close by EOD Fri?
Diego R.: For the POC we recommended Dedicated-4 (2x A10G equiv). Customer asked for expected p99 latency at 2k tokens and 100 concurrent users — I can share perf bench but need confirmation of node count + burst policy.
Erin K.: They uploaded a 60-question security questionnaire (network diagrams, KMS, SOC2 scope). I can answer infra and app-level Qs, but need a KMS/HSM owner to confirm key lifecycle and whether we allow customer-managed keys in VPC private deployment.
Ben L.: Reviewing the DPA redline — customer insists on unlimited audit rights and 30-day deletion after termination. We should push for scoped audit (pre-notified, business hours, limited to systems processing their data) and standard 90-day retention to allow for backups. Also they added a clause tying SLA credits to revenue; need to limit liability.
Carla M.: Finance note — they require PO number on invoice and vendor W9 equivalent for US entity. Are we okay with Net30? Typically we do Net30 for enterprise deals but confirm sales discounting if committed capacity. Also need SOW/orderform value to create invoice draft.
Alice S.: Can legal/finance confirm acceptability of Net30 and whether we can make a countersign exception for this POC? They said procurement won't release the PO until MSA countersigned. Also they requested sequential signing: Legal -> Finance -> CTO. Do we have a DocuSign flow for sequential signers?
Diego R.: Yes, DocuSign supports sequential routing. Example (SE note):
```
POST /envelopes
{"workflow":{"workflowSteps":[{"action":"SEQUENTIAL","signers":[{"roleName":"Legal"},{"roleName":"Finance"},{"roleName":"CTO"}]},...]}}
```
Set templateId to our standard MSA template and `routingOrder` accordingly. Ops can attach orderform as attachment.
Erin K.: I've uploaded SOC2 Type II summary to the compliance bucket: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-summary.pdf — share that with the customer. On KMS: for Hosted we use provider KMS, for Private we can support customer KMS via bring-your-own-key (BYOK) — need SE to confirm steps for the POC.
Ben L.: Proposed compromise on DPA: 1) audit rights limited to once-per-year formal audits unless material issue, 2) data deletion: certify deletion of customer content within 90 days plus attest deletion from backups within 180 days, 3) liability cap tied to fees paid in prior 12 months. If customer pushes back hard on 30-day deletion, we can offer an escrow/attestation mechanism.
Carla M.: If we accept Net30, we can fast-track invoice once PO is in. For committed Reserved capacity we need a signed orderform with committed spend to set billing start date. If POC converts to committed, billing changes are straightforward.
Alice S.: Action items: @Diego R. — confirm BYOK steps and perf estimate today. @Erin K. — populate SQ answers for infra and attach SOC2. @Ben L. — push back on unlimited audit + 30d deletion and propose the compromise language. @Carla M. — prepare invoice template and sample orderform with committed capacity options. I'll ping the customer to try to get PO number and request countersign window.
Ops Bot: Created internal ticket PO-2026-0998 to track Solarity Health PO and invoice (owner: Carla M.).
Diego R.: Quick perf note for legal/finance: for Dedicated-4 under typical load we see p95 ~ 120ms token gen for 2k token windows; p99 depends on KV cache hit rate — if we enable prefix cache we keep p99 < 500ms for the targeted concurrency. I'll attach short bench CSV to the ticket.
Erin K.: One more blocker: customer wants SOC2 auditor contact and scope of in-scope services. We only share the SOC2 report with an NDA. Ben, can legal approve a short NDA or limited disclosure agreement so we can share the full report?
Ben L.: Yes, we can provide SOC2 under a standard confidentiality addendum. I'll draft a one-pager NDA and post here by EOD. If they sign, we can share full SOC2.
Alice S.: Great — if we get PO + NDA by Thursday we can start provisioning Monday. I'll coordinate with the customer on signer order and share the DocuSign link once Ben confirms MSA language. Thanks everyone, will update as items close.
